config.title: Jev Security Linter
config.model.description: Decision AI model to use (OpenRouter model slug)
config.maxBranchCount.description: Number of branch divisions / parallel questions per API request (2-64, default: 8). Higher values reduce scan latency/round-trips but increase input token consumption (cost).
config.minimumBlockSize.description: Minimum block size (lines) to stop branch division (pinpoint line granularity)
config.overlapRatio.description: Boundary overlap ratio between adjacent branch blocks (0.0 - 0.4). Overlap lines = floor(lines * ratio)
config.maxChunkChars.description: Maximum character length per model request. Larger blocks are divided locally without API calls to stay within context limits.
config.warnUnresolvedBlocks.description: When enabled, issues warnings for entire parent blocks if a security risk was suspected but could not be pinpointed to individual sub-blocks (e.g. cross-line dependencies).
config.enableCache.description: Enable in-memory LRU caching of evaluated code blocks to skip redundant API requests upon repeated saves.
config.cacheMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of code block hash entries to keep in memory.
config.supportedLanguages.description: List of language IDs to automatically scan
config.includePattern.description: Regular expression pattern of file paths to include for batch scanning (empty matches all supported language files)
config.excludePattern.description: Regular expression pattern of file paths to exclude from scanning
config.useGitignore.description: Whether to respect .gitignore exclusion rules when collecting files to scan
config.rules.description: List of evaluation rules and categories with custom targets and severity levels
